# Interview Reader

> Free interview questions with detailed answers for Java, React, Node.js, Go, SQL, System Design, Kafka, Microservices, Design Patterns, Angular and Rails, plus 1,500+ coding problems you can run online in 11 languages.

Every question has its own page at a readable URL, for example `https://interviewreader.cloud/what-is-the-bulkhead-pattern`. Some topics are members-only; the free sample is open to everyone.

## Main pages

- [Coding problems](https://interviewreader.cloud/problems): 1,500+ problems with test cases, filterable by topic and difficulty.
- [Practice coding online](https://interviewreader.cloud/practice): online editor that runs Java, Python, C++, Go, JavaScript and more.
- [Home](https://interviewreader.cloud/): browse interview questions by technology.

## Machine-readable index

- [Sitemap](https://interviewreader.cloud/sitemap.xml): every public question and problem URL.
